The main takeaway from our work is that
the developing brain is highly vulnerable to organophosphate-induced neurotoxicity and that the specific targets of this toxicity vary with the agent.
the 5HT system, in particular, may be a key target for the neurobehavioral effects of organophosphates in developing animals.
